summary: Bongo Seakhoa, also publicly known as Bongo Kosa, is a data scientist and data engineer focused on reliable analytics systems, applied machine learning, and cloud-enabled data workflows.

His background combines hands-on technical delivery with mentoring and learner support across remote teams. He works across Python, SQL, GCP, AWS, analytics tooling, and technical communication for operators, students, and stakeholders.

He is currently pursuing a BSc in Engineering Management at the University of Debrecen while continuing to build a public portfolio of cloud, analytics, and machine learning work. He has also completed University of Colorado Boulder coursework via Coursera covering data mining, statistical inference, and probability foundations.
identity.identity_note: Bongo Seakhoa and Bongo Kosa refer to the same professional profile. Seakhoa is the surname used across LinkedIn, Coursera, and GitHub, while Kosa remains an important public-facing surname for discovery and continuity.
